warnings: op1 direct read (house 11). NEW ELEMENT TYPE this sheet: CS = steel column (C-150x100x3.2mm channel), 2 confirmed at grid-2 line (B-2 and ~C-2), base-plated onto the RC ring beam via a welded PL-150x150x6mm plate + 4-Ø16mm anchor bolts. Likely supports the roof valley/ridge post system at the twin-gable meeting line (grid 2) — matches the CX-post pattern from houses 08-10 but here as a steel section, not a concrete post.

B6X stub beam (west of grid 1) and the earlier-flagged small room appendage on S-04 are STILL NOT fully resolved by this sheet — the 1.11/1.50 offsets here don't obviously connect to the ramp geometry (A-13/A-14) or to the north/south C0 footings either. This open question is carried forward, not fabricated an answer for.

The C0 footings north of A / south of D remain UNEXPLAINED after S-02 through S-05 — no beam on this ring-beam sheet reaches the A' or D' dummy grid lines. Will check S-06 (roof frame) and S-07 (fascia detail) next.
